messages.content: I want to order a custom bronze sculpture of a horse. What material options are available?

function.name: painting_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom painting with your preferred color. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

subject.description: The subject of the painting, e.g. horse

color.description: Preferred main color for the painting.

size.description: The desired size for the painting in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

function.name: sculpture_create_custom
function.description: Order a custom sculpture with your preferred material. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

item.description: The subject of the sculpture, e.g. horse

size.description: The desired size for the sculpture in inches. This parameter is optional. Default 12

message.content:
The available material options for a custom sculpture are:

- Bronze
- Marble
- Terracotta
- Wood
- Stone

Let me know if you’d like to proceed with a Bronze sculpture of a horse or if you have any other preferences!
